text: 1. Short title, extent and commencement.- (1) This Act may be called the Model Regulation Act, 2026.
2. It extends to the whole of Pakistan.
3. It shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.- In this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context, "Authority" means the Model Regulation Authority constituted under section 4.
3. Application.- This Act shall apply to every person carrying on a regulated activity in Pakistan.
